36864-school-reading-by-grades-sixth-yea.title: _Sixth Year_
36864-school-reading-by-grades-sixth-yea.creator: James Baldwin
36864-school-reading-by-grades-sixth-yea.description: A book by James Baldwin. ost every variety of English composition. To assist in their comprehension, many of the selections are introduced or followed by brief historical or bibliographical notes. Hints also are given as to collateral, or supplementary readings on a variety of subjects.

43519-commentary-on-the-maya-manuscript-.title: Royal Public Library Of Dresden
43519-commentary-on-the-maya-manuscript-.creator: Unknown
43519-commentary-on-the-maya-manuscript-.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Some of those who examine this book will say, that it is too early for a commentary on the "Dresdensis," since Maya research is yet in its infancy, and this opinion is certainly justified inasmuch as a final explanation of that remarkable monument is, of course, impossible at the present time.

52319-the-genealogy-of-morals-the-comple.title: A Polemic
52319-the-genealogy-of-morals-the-comple.creator: Unknown
52319-the-genealogy-of-morals-the-comple.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. As far as the rest of life with its so-called "experiences" is concerned, which of us has even sufficient serious interest? In our dealings with such points of life, we are, I fear, never properly to the point; to be precise, our heart is not there, and certainly not our ear.

arxiv-2102-08592.title: Reduced-Order Models for Thermal Radiative Transfer Based on POD-Galerkin Method and Low-Order Quasidiffusion Equations
arxiv-2102-08592.creator: Joseph M. Coale, Dmitriy Y. Anistratov
arxiv-2102-08592.description: Abstract This paper presents a new technique for developing reduced-order models (ROMs) for nonlinear radiative transfer problems in high-energy density physics. The proper orthogonal decomposition (POD) of photon intensities is applied to obtain global basis functions for the Galerkin projection (POD-Galerkin) of the time-dependent multigroup Boltzmann transport equation (BTE) for photons.

arxiv-2109-00951.title: GAM: Explainable Visual Similarity and Classification via Gradient Activation Maps
arxiv-2109-00951.creator: Oren Barkan, Omri Armstrong, Amir Hertz, Avi Caciularu, Ori Katz, Itzik Malkiel, Noam Koenigstein
arxiv-2109-00951.description: Abstract . We present Gradient Activation Maps (GAM) - a machinery for explaining predictions made by visual similarity and classification models. By gleaning localized gradient and activation information from multiple network layers, GAM offers improved visual explanations, when compared to existing alternatives.

arxiv-2304-03805.title: Correcting Model Misspecification via Generative Adversarial Networks
arxiv-2304-03805.creator: Pronoma Banerjee, Manasi V Gude, Rajvi J Sampat, Sharvari M Hedaoo, Soma Dhavala, Snehanshu Saha
arxiv-2304-03805.description: Abstract Machine learning models are often misspecified in the likelihood, which leads to a lack of robustness in the predictions. In this paper, we introduce a framework for correcting likelihood misspecifications in several paradigm agnostic noisy prior models and test the model’s ability to remove the misspecification.

arxiv-2310-19474.title: Structure-Informed Neural Networks for Boundary Observation Problems
arxiv-2310-19474.creator: Jakub Horsky, Andrew Wynn
arxiv-2310-19474.description: Abstract We introduce Structure Informed Neural Networks (SINNs), a novel method for solving boundary observation problems involving PDEs. The SINN methodology is a data-driven framework for creating approximate solutions to internal variables on the interior of a domain, given only boundary data.

arxiv-2408-04061.title: Traces of powers of random matrices over local fields
arxiv-2408-04061.creator: Noam Pirani
arxiv-2408-04061.description: Abstract Let M M be chosen uniformly at random w.r.t. the Haar measure on the unitary group U n U_{n} , the unitary symplectic group U ​ S ​ p 2 ​ n USp_{2n} or the orthogonal group O n O_{n} .

arxiv-2409-16438.title: Glitch in Time: Exploiting Temporal Misalignment of IMU for Eavesdropping
arxiv-2409-16438.creator: Ahmed Najeeb, Abdul Rafay, Muhammad Hamad Alizai, Naveed Anwar Bhatti
arxiv-2409-16438.description: Abstract . The increasing use of voice assistants and related applications has raised significant concerns about the security of Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs) in smartphones. These devices are vulnerable to acoustic eavesdropping attacks, jeopardizing user privacy. In response, Google imposed a rate limit of 200 Hz on permission-free access to IMUs, aiming to neutralize such side-channel attacks.

arxiv-2411-11090.title: ForPKG: A Framework for Constructing Forestry Policy Knowledge Graph and Application Analysis
arxiv-2411-11090.creator: Jingyun Sun, Zhongze Luo ∗
arxiv-2411-11090.description: Abstract A policy knowledge graph can provide decision support for tasks such as project compliance, policy analysis, and intelligent question answering, and can also serve as an external knowledge base to assist the reasoning process of related large language models.

arxiv-2412-15659.title: Strain tuning of the nonlinear anomalous Hall effect in MoS 2 \textrm{MoS}_{2} monolayer
arxiv-2412-15659.creator: Yuebei Xiong, Zhirui Gong, Hao Jin
arxiv-2412-15659.description: Abstract Due to the time reversal symmetry, the linear anomalous Hall effect (AHE) usually vanishes in MoS 2 \textrm{MoS}_{2} monolayer. In contrast, the nonlinear AHE plays an essential role in such system when the uniaxial strain breaks the C 3 ​ v C_{3v} symmetry and eventually results in the nonzero Berry curvature dipole (BCD).

arxiv-2504-20549.title: Type A algebraic coherence conjecture of Pappas and Rapoport
arxiv-2504-20549.creator: Evgeny Feigin
arxiv-2504-20549.description: Abstract . The Pappas–Rapoport coherence conjecture, proved by Zhu, states that the dimensions of spaces of sections of certain line bundles coincide. The two sides of the equality correspond to line bundles on spherical Schubert varieties in affine Grassmannians and to line bundles on unions of Schubert varieties in affine flag varieties.

arxiv-2505-08238.title: Motion Control of High-Dimensional Musculoskeletal Systems with Hierarchical Model-Based Planning
arxiv-2505-08238.creator: Yunyue Wei, Shanning Zhuang, Vincent Zhuang, Yanan Sui
arxiv-2505-08238.description: Abstract Controlling high-dimensional nonlinear systems, such as those found in biological and robotic applications, is challenging due to large state and action spaces. While deep reinforcement learning has achieved a number of successes in these domains, it is computationally intensive and time consuming, and therefore not suitable for solving large collections of tasks that require significant manual tuning.

arxiv-2506-07290.title: Stochastic Moving Anchor Algorithms and a Popov’s Scheme with Moving Anchor Thanks: James K. Alcala was partially supported by a UCR Dissertation Year Program Award. Thanks: Yat Tin Chow is partially supported by a Regents’ Faculty Fellowship at the University of California, Riverside, and by NSF DM
arxiv-2506-07290.creator: James K. Alcala, Yat Tin Chow, Mahesh Sunkula
arxiv-2506-07290.description: Abstract . Since their introduction, anchoring methods in extragradient-type saddlepoint problems have inspired a flurry of research due to their ability to provide order-optimal rates of accelerated convergence in very general problem settings. Such guarantees are especially important as researchers consider problems in artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML), where large problem sizes demand immense computational power.

arxiv-2509-06049.title: Optimized Split Computing Framework for Edge and Core Devices
arxiv-2509-06049.creator: Andrea Tassi, Oluwatayo Yetunde Kolawole, Joan Pujol Roig, Daniel Warren
arxiv-2509-06049.description: Abstract With mobile networks expected to support services with stringent requirements that ensure high-quality user experience, the ability to apply Feed-Forward Neural Network (FFNN) models to User Equipment (UE) use cases has become critical. Given that UEs have limited resources, running FFNNs directly on UEs is an intrinsically challenging problem.

arxiv-2511-18034.title: A q q -analogue of the Koecher-Leshchiner generating function of odd zeta values
arxiv-2511-18034.creator: Roberto Tauraso
arxiv-2511-18034.description: Abstract . In the 1980s, Koecher and, independently, Leshchiner found an elegant formula for the generating function of odd zeta values. In this short note, we derive a q q -analogue of this formula, which provides a q q -version of the accelerated series for ζ ⁡ ( 3 ) \zeta(3) used by Apéry in his famous proof of irrationality.

arxiv-2601-17549.title: Breaking the Protocol: Security Analysis of the Model Context Protocol Specification and Prompt Injection Vulnerabilities in Tool-Integrated LLM Agents
arxiv-2601-17549.creator: Narek Maloyan and Dmitry Namiot
arxiv-2601-17549.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Narek Maloyan and Dmitry Namiot. The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has emerged as a de facto standard for integrating Large Language Models with external tools, yet no formal security analysis of the protocol specification exists. We present the first rigorous security analysis of MCP’s architectural design, identifying three fundamental protocol-level vulnerabilities: (1) absence of capability attestation allowing servers to claim arbitrary permissions, (2) bidirectional sampling without origin authentication enabling server-side prompt injection, and (3) implicit trust propagation in multi-server configurations.

arxiv-2604-05503.title: Exact solution of three-point functions in critical loop models
arxiv-2604-05503.creator: Morris Ang, Gefei Cai, Jesper Lykke Jacobsen, Rongvoram Nivesvivat, Paul Roux, Xin Sun, Baojun Wu

govdocs-archive_org-nsia-FBIFainJohnWSA_.creator: U.S. Senate Select Committee to Study Governmental Operations with Respect to Intelligence Activities
govdocs-archive_org-nsia-FBIFainJohnWSA_.description: Book V of the Church Committee's final report on the performance of the intelligence agencies in the investigation of President Kennedy's assassination — including the FBI's handling of Oswald and SA John W. Fain's 1962 interview of him.

my-double-life-the-memoirs-of-sarah-bern.title: My Double Life: The Memoirs of Sarah Bernhardt
my-double-life-the-memoirs-of-sarah-bern.creator: Sarah Bernhardt

pmc-10503210.title: A whole-body diffusion MRI normal atlas: development, evaluation and initial use
pmc-10503210.creator: Therese Sjöholm, Sambit Tarai, Filip Malmberg, Robin Strand, Alexander Korenyushkin, Gunilla Enblad, Håkan Ahlström, Joel Kullberg
pmc-10503210.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundStatistical atlases can provide population-based descriptions of healthy volunteers and/or patients and can be used for region- and voxel-based analysis. This work aims to develop whole-body diffusion atlases of healthy volunteers scanned at 1.5T and 3T.

pmc-11333225.title: Effects of post-acute COVID-19 syndrome on cerebral white matter and emotional health among non-hospitalized individuals
pmc-11333225.creator: Nathan W. Churchill, Eugenie Roudaia, J. Jean Chen, Allison Sekuler, Fuqiang Gao, Mario Masellis, Benjamin Lam, Ivy Cheng, Chris Heyn, Sandra E. Black, Bradley J. MacIntosh, Simon J. Graham, Tom A. Schweizer
pmc-11333225.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). IntroductionPost-acute COVID syndrome (PACS) is a growing concern, given its impact on mental health and quality of life. However, its effects on cerebral white matter remain poorly understood, particularly in non-hospitalized cohorts.

pmc-11544140.title: Dual pathway inhibition with faricimab for previously treated neovascular age-related macular degeneration and diabetic macular oedema: guidance from a UK panel of retina specialists
pmc-11544140.creator: Louise Downey, Sobha Sivaprasad, Ramandeep Chhabra, Clare Bailey, Soma Chakrabarti, Samer Elsherbiny, Jignesh Patel, Giuliana Silvestri, Sarah-Lucie Watson, Gwyn Williams, Antony Parker, Saima Khokhar, Andrew Lotery
pmc-11544140.description: Background/objectivesSome eyes with neovascular age-related macular degeneration (nAMD) and centre-involving diabetic macular oedema (DMO) fail to respond sufficiently or lose response over time to standard of care intravitreal anti-vascular endothelial growth factor (anti-VEGF) therapy. This paper explores clinical scenarios for switching to dual action angiopoietin-2 (Ang-2)/VEGF-A inhibitor faricimab (Vabysmo, Roche Products Limited) in previously anti-VEGF-treated patients.

pmc-11547552.title: A Facile Synthesis of RGO-Ag2MoO4 Nanocomposites for Efficient Lead Removal from Aqueous Solution
pmc-11547552.creator: Mohd Shoeb, Fouzia Mashkoor, Mohmmad Naved Khan, Changyoon Jeong, Barbara Bonelli
pmc-11547552.description: Efficiently treating wastewater, particularly the elimination of heavy metal ions from water systems, continues to be one of the most pressing and complex challenges in modern environmental management. In this work, reduced graphene oxide coupled silver molybdate binary nanocomposites (RGO-Ag2MoO4 NCs) have been prepared via hydrothermal method.

pmc-12582145.title: Current Landscape of Children's Surgery in Africa: A Multicenter Analysis of 16,000 Cases
pmc-12582145.creator: Phillip J Hsu, Madeleine Carroll, Alan Zambeli‐Ljepovic, Bolusefe Tijesuni Olatunji‐Banire, Pawan Mathew, Jason Axt, Thierno Diallo, Mekonen Eshete, Bertille Ki, Joseph Macharia, George Ngock, Absalat Serawit, Emma Bryce, Doruk Ozgediz, Maija Cheung
pmc-12582145.description: BackgroundAlthough prior studies have estimated the burden of pediatric surgical disease in low‐ and middle‐income countries (LMICs) through statistical modeling and hospital‐ or household‐based surveys, few large‐scale descriptions of procedures and outcomes have been published. We aimed to describe the epidemiology and outcomes of children's surgical care at multiple centers across Africa.

pmc-12609707.title: In Silico Characterisation and Determination of Gene Expression Levels of the CPK Family Under Saline Stress Conditions in Chenopodium quinoa Willd
pmc-12609707.creator: Luz Lima-Huanca, Andrea Alvarez-Vasquez, María Valderrama-Valencia, Sandro Condori-Pacsi
pmc-12609707.description: Quinoa (Chenopodium quinoa Willd.) is a highly nutritious crop known for its tolerance to salt stress; however, the molecular mechanisms underlying this trait remain poorly understood. This study aims to perform the in silico characterisation of calcium-dependent protein kinase (CPK) gene family sequences and to evaluate their expression profiles under salt stress conditions.

pmc-12657818.title: Tea eggs-inspired Pickering emulsion stabilized by cooked egg white protein-EGCG complexes: Astaxanthin loading and 3D printing.
pmc-12657818.creator: Xinru Gao, Xu Zhong, Qian Zhang, Yinxu Zhang, Wentao Su, Xiaomei Liu, Mingqian Tan, Hao Wu
pmc-12657818.description: Astaxanthin (AXT) demonstrates significant potential in food applications due to its diverse biological activities. However, its practical implementation is constrained by poor water solubility, environmental instability, and low bioavailability. This study aimed to leverage Pickering emulsions stabilized by heat-denatured egg white protein (EWP)-EGCG complexes as carriers for AXT encapsulation, and exploring the system's feasibility in 3D food printing.

pmc-13217819.title: Switching to alternative tobacco products during unsuccessful smoking quit attempts is not linked to improved quit intention or interest
pmc-13217819.creator: Julia N. Soulakova, Lisa J. Crockett
pmc-13217819.description: BackgroundAmong adults who smoke cigarettes daily, attempts to quit smoking may involve using alternative tobacco products (ATPs) or evidence-based cessation aids, such as Nicotine Replacement Therapy (NRT). This study examined use of ATPs and aids during the last serious smoking quit attempt as well as quit intentions and interest in quitting among adults who smoke daily.

pmc-13555294.title: Conscious vision: investigating visual hallucination awareness in Lewy body disease
pmc-13555294.creator: Desirée Conti, Tommaso Accinni, Alice Teghil, Dominic ffytche, Giulia Zazzaro, Massimiliano Panigutti, Giulia Bechi Gabrielli, Antonio Suppa, Marco Fiorelli, Francesca Caramia, Giuseppe Bruno, Cecilia Guariglia, Fabrizia D’Antonio
pmc-13555294.description: Visual awareness includes the ability to distinguish internally generated sensory experience from veridical percepts derived from the external world. Visual hallucinations (VHs) are an example of internally generated experience with important clinical implications and are common in Lewy body disease (LBD), with some patients aware of their hallucinations and others not.

pmc-13676793.title: Histological evaluation of three-dimensional rectangular grid plates in treatment of mandibular fractures: an experimental study
pmc-13676793.creator: Mohamed Mohsen Elbanna, Ibrahim H. Ahmed, Mohamed Hassan Eid, Mohamed Elsholkamy, Mohamed Said Hamed
pmc-13676793.description: Aim of the workEvaluate the efficacy of 3D rectangular grid plates in treatment of mandibular fractures in comparison to the more commonly used locking plates.Subjects and methodsThis experimental study was conducted on sixteen mature male Mongrel dogs (ranged from 1-2 years old), weighting about 15-20 kg each.
